Back up a file, with an optional timestamp

Source: R/bag_backup.R
bag_backup.Rd

Copies a file into a backup directory, appending a stamp to the name so successive backups sit alongside each other rather than replacing one another.

Usage

bag_backup(
  path_dir_in,
  path_in_file,
  path_dir_out,
  stamp = format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d%H%M")
)

Arguments

path_dir_in

character Directory holding the file.

path_in_file

character Name of the file, within path_dir_in.

path_dir_out

character Directory to copy into. Created if absent.

stamp

character Appended to the file's base name, before the extension. Defaults to the current time as YYYYMMDDHHMM. NULL appends nothing, which means the backup collides with any earlier one of the same name.

Value

character The path written, invisibly.

See also

bag_gpkg_refresh() for a GeoPackage whose coordinate columns are refreshed as well, with csv and RData copies alongside.

Other files: bag_gpkg_refresh(), bag_gpkg_to_geojson(), bag_layers()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
bag_backup(
  path_dir_in = file.path(tempdir(), "my_project"),
  path_in_file = "background_layers.gpkg",
  path_dir_out = file.path(tempdir(), "backups")
)
} # }
